changelog: Motor do carro (beta): DriveHub tenta aparecer no menu do iDrive com telas próprias e capa do Spotify na tela do carro — ativo quando o login BMW Apps conecta. Correção: card do Spotify enxerga o app instalado.
changelogEn: Car engine (beta): DriveHub tries to appear in the iDrive menu with its own screens and Spotify cover art on the car display — active when the BMW Apps login connects. Fix: the Spotify card now sees the installed app.
